name: ai-developer-debugger
description: MCP-powered agentic AI debugging platform that investigates errors across source code, git history, and documentation.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace shared && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
